messages:
Taylor: Spotted something funky on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate in na-east during the canary: p50 flat, p95 jumped, p99 way up. Looks like merged percentiles disagree with the raw histogram.
Hannah: Which canary and what routing change?
Taylor: Canary ramped 14:02 -> 14:12. We shifted 15% of traffic to slow-path. Panel query: `percentile(50,95,99) by endpoint` with 1m step and 3m EMA smoothing.
Ibrahim: If console merges t-digests that were computed per-route then smooths, you can get non-monotonic estimates. Did you check per-route counts?
Taylor: Per-route: main-route count ~ 1800, slow-path count = 7. Slow-path p95=2.8s, main p95=0.16s. Merged p95 jumped to 1.1s during ramp.
console-team: Confirmed pipeline: per-route t-digests -> merge -> quantile extraction -> smoothing for charts. We did that to keep load down.
telemetry: alert: merged_p95_delta 420% for /v1/generate (detected 2026-02-17T14:08Z)
Hannah: Two angles: UX (explain why) and infra (reduce false alarms). For UX we should surface per-route pcts and a confidence indicator when contributor counts are tiny.
Ibrahim: Infra options: (A) compute percentiles from merged raw histograms (exact, more CPU), (B) keep merged t-digests but attach contributor metadata so consumers can judge confidence, (C) short-lived exact histogram cache for recent windows.
Taylor: I have a proposal: add an internal provenance API that returns {merged_pctls, contributors:[{route, samples, pctls}], routing_timeline} so console can show merged + per-route columns and an overlay of routing weights. Thoughts?
console-team: Love it. That keeps heavy recompute on backend and lets UI render confidently. We'll need an opt-in flag to enable computing per-route pctls for high-cardinality endpoints to avoid cost blowup.
Hannah: For alerting: change rules to prefer per-route p95 deltas when merged_sample_count < 50, and mark merged alerts as low-confidence. Also add a suppression window during canary ramps.
Ibrahim: One caution: contributors array should include sample centroids and counts so we can detect tdigest centroid collisions. Also include a checksum so UI can request an exact recompute if checksums change unexpectedly.
console-team: UX sketch: merged line + faded per-route lines, a provenance pill that opens a drawer showing contributors table and routing timeline, and an "Exact recompute" button. If merged_p50>merged_p95 show a red hint "sketch inconsistency" with quick repro steps.
telemetry: info: captured raw bucket dump for /v1/generate 14:00-14:15 to /tmp/diag-1869990000.tar.gz
Taylor: I'll open the RFC for provenance API and tag ingest + console. Quick mitigation: console team, can you add a visible sample-count threshold and change alerting to avoid paging on merged pctls with low counts?
console-team: Yep. We'll add a prominent sample-count pill and change tooltip text: "Merged percentiles may be skewed when any contributor has <25 samples; click to see per-route breakdown." PR planned for tomorrow.
Ibrahim: I'll add a tdigest-merge diagnostic flag in ingest that logs contributor counts+centroids when merged p95 changes >20%. That should help root cause vs. real tail.
Hannah: Action items recap: Taylor -> RFC and replay attached; console-team -> UI badge + per-route view + tooltip; Ibrahim -> diagnostic flag + provenance API prototype; telemetry -> keep the raw dump. Let's reconvene after PRs land.
Taylor: Thanks all. Leaving the captured dump and a short GIF in the issue. :white_check_mark:
